entities.name: PMID:10726964
observations: Sakisaka et al. reported immunohistochemical and immunoblot assessment of hepatic HSP70 and ubiquitin in primary biliary cirrhosis before and after UDCA treatment. PMID:10726964; Liver, 2000 Feb.

entities.name: UDCA lowers hepatic HSP70
observations: In PBC liver samples (n=34), HSP70 and ubiquitin labeling in bile ducts and hepatocytes significantly decreased after UDCA treatment (P<0.01); abstract reports before/after treatment but no effect size.
